verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents in-product AI features: Composer builds audiences, drafts content and maps send strategy from a stated goal, K:AI picks the best-performing channel per message, and there is an AI subject-line generator. These amount to data-driven suggestions, but the evidence never describes in-app AI-generated insights or analysis of performance data. Flow performance reports are only offered through the external MCP client, not inside the product. missing for 10: in-product AI insights/analytics on account data, detail on how suggestions are derived from customer data, independent or hands-on corroboration.
